# Australian building-object glossary

Generated from the canonical ontology export. Definitions are original plain-English summaries, not reproduced standards text.

## AAC U-section unit

**ID:** `AU-MA-AAC-U-SECTION`  
**Category:** aac units  
**Status:** accepted

A U-shaped AAC unit used as permanent form to a local reinforced and filled horizontal beam, ring beam or opening support within an AAC wall system.

Accepted search terms: AAC channel block.

Main functions: Form a horizontal reinforcement channel; Provide an AAC-compatible outer substrate; Contain specified grout or concrete infill.

## AAC block masonry wall

**ID:** `AU-MA-AAC-BLOCK-WALL`  
**Category:** aac assemblies  
**Status:** accepted

A wall assembled from AAC masonry blocks with compatible thin joints, opening supports, movement joints, ties or anchors, moisture controls and surface finishes required by the selected system.

Accepted search terms: AAC blockwork.

Main functions: Enclose or divide space; Carry documented wall actions; Provide a lightweight solid masonry background.

## AAC closure unit

**ID:** `AU-MA-AAC-CLOSURE-UNIT`  
**Category:** aac units  
**Status:** accepted

A thin, short or otherwise sized AAC unit used to close a course, cover a junction, complete a return or cap a local AAC assembly.

Accepted search terms: AAC closure block.

Main functions: Complete AAC modular geometry; Close exposed ends or interfaces; Provide a compatible finish substrate.

## AAC masonry block

**ID:** `AU-MA-AAC-MASONRY-BLOCK`  
**Category:** aac units  
**Status:** accepted

An unreinforced or locally reinforced autoclaved aerated concrete unit laid in courses, commonly with thin-bed adhesive, to form an AAC masonry wall.

Accepted search terms: aerated concrete block, Hebel block.

Main functions: Form AAC block masonry; Provide a cuttable modular wall unit; Receive compatible finishes and fixings.

## AAC movement-joint assembly

**ID:** `AU-MA-AAC-MOVEMENT-JOINT-ASSEMBLY`  
**Category:** aac joint materials  
**Status:** accepted

A deliberate gap and compatible edge, backing and seal components that divide AAC work into panels or separate it from dissimilar structure so documented movement can occur.

Accepted search terms: AAC control joint.

Main functions: Accommodate relative movement; Separate AAC from dissimilar construction; Maintain weather, air or fire continuity through a selected joint system.

## AAC panel reinforcement cage

**ID:** `AU-MA-AAC-PANEL-REINFORCEMENT-CAGE`  
**Category:** aac panel components  
**Status:** accepted

A factory-positioned protected steel mesh or cage embedded through a reinforced AAC panel or member to provide its designed reinforcement.

Accepted search terms: AAC panel reinforcing mesh.

Main functions: Reinforce the AAC panel; Transfer actions to bearings or fixings; Control documented cracking and handling actions.

## AAC patching mortar

**ID:** `AU-MA-AAC-PATCH-MORTAR`  
**Category:** aac joint materials  
**Status:** accepted

A compatible repair material used to fill local chips, service chases, fixing recesses or surface damage in AAC before the selected finish is applied.

Accepted search terms: AAC repair mortar.

Main functions: Repair local AAC loss; Restore finish substrate continuity; Fill approved minor chases or recesses.

## AAC sill unit

**ID:** `AU-MA-AAC-SILL-UNIT`  
**Category:** aac units  
**Status:** accepted

A shaped or cut AAC unit forming the masonry base below an opening and providing the substrate for the selected sill, flashing and finish detail.

Accepted search terms: AAC sill block.

Main functions: Complete AAC masonry below an opening; Form a sloped or shaped sill substrate; Receive compatible weathering details.

## AAC thin-bed adhesive

**ID:** `AU-MA-AAC-THIN-BED-ADHESIVE`  
**Category:** aac joint materials  
**Status:** accepted

A compatible cementitious adhesive applied in thin joints between AAC blocks or panels instead of ordinary thick masonry mortar in the selected system.

Accepted search terms: AAC block adhesive.

Main functions: Bond adjoining AAC surfaces; Form controlled thin joints; Transfer local actions through the selected system.

## AWTS aeration chamber

**ID:** `AU-DR-AWTS-AERATION-CHAMBER`  
**Category:** awts components  
**Status:** accepted

A treatment-tank compartment where air and wastewater contact active biological growth on suspended solids or media.

Accepted search terms: aeration tank.

Main functions: Hold the aerobic treatment volume; Receive distributed air; Support biological oxidation and mixing.

## AWTS air blower

**ID:** `AU-DR-AWTS-AIR-BLOWER`  
**Category:** awts components  
**Status:** accepted

An electrically driven air pump supplying continuous or controlled low-pressure air to treatment diffusers or airlift devices.

Accepted search terms: aerator blower.

Main functions: Supply process air; Drive diffusers or airlifts; Maintain aerobic treatment conditions.

## AWTS air diffuser

**ID:** `AU-DR-AWTS-AIR-DIFFUSER`  
**Category:** awts components  
**Status:** accepted

A perforated, porous or membrane device submerged in the aeration chamber to divide supplied air into bubbles and distribute it through the wastewater.

Accepted search terms: aeration diffuser.

Main functions: Disperse process air; Transfer oxygen into wastewater; Mix the aeration chamber.

## AWTS air-distribution manifold

**ID:** `AU-DR-AWTS-AIR-MANIFOLD`  
**Category:** awts components  
**Status:** accepted

A network of air pipes, valves and branches distributing blower air to diffusers, airlifts or separate treatment zones.

Accepted search terms: airline manifold.

Main functions: Divide blower airflow; Connect air devices; Permit balancing or isolation of air branches.

## AWTS biological treatment media

**ID:** `AU-DR-AWTS-BIOLOGICAL-MEDIA`  
**Category:** awts components  
**Status:** accepted

A fixed, suspended or moving high-surface-area material inside a treatment chamber on which biological growth can develop.

Accepted search terms: bio-media.

Main functions: Provide surface for attached biological growth; Retain active biomass; Support the selected treatment process.

## AWTS chlorine dosing unit

**ID:** `AU-DR-AWTS-CHLORINATOR`

**Status:** accepted

A tablet feeder, liquid dosing pump or other controlled device introducing an approved chlorine disinfectant into treated effluent.

## AWTS clarification chamber

**ID:** `AU-DR-AWTS-CLARIFIER`  
**Category:** awts components  
**Status:** accepted

A quiet downstream chamber or hopper where biological solids settle from aerated wastewater before clarified liquid moves to disinfection or storage.

Accepted search terms: secondary clarifier.

Main functions: Settle suspended biological solids; Provide clarified overflow; Collect solids for return or wasting.

## AWTS effluent-disinfection assembly

**ID:** `AU-DR-AWTS-DISINFECTION-ASSEMBLY`  
**Category:** awts disinfection  
**Status:** accepted

Accepted search terms: disinfection unit.

Main functions: Expose effluent to the selected disinfecting process; Provide contact or irradiation conditions; Allow replenishment, cleaning, sampling and fault monitoring.

## AWTS sludge-return airlift

**ID:** `AU-DR-AWTS-SLUDGE-RETURN-AIRLIFT`  
**Category:** awts components  
**Status:** accepted

A vertical pipe and air-injection device using rising bubbles to lift settled sludge from a clarifier back to an upstream treatment chamber.

Accepted search terms: sludge airlift.

Main functions: Return settled biomass; Use blower air without a submerged mechanical pump; Control solids circulation.

## AWTS ultraviolet disinfection unit

**ID:** `AU-DR-AWTS-UV-DISINFECTION-UNIT`  
**Category:** awts disinfection  
**Status:** accepted

An enclosed flow chamber containing an ultraviolet lamp and protective sleeve that irradiates clarified effluent as it passes through.

Accepted search terms: UV steriliser.

Main functions: Expose effluent to UV radiation; Provide a controlled flow chamber; Monitor lamp or power faults.

## Class 1 separating-wall sound-insulation system

**ID:** `AU-HA-CLASS1-SOUND-INSULATION-SYSTEM`

## Class 10c private bushfire-shelter assembly

**ID:** `AU-AN-PRIVATE-BUSHFIRE-SHELTER-ASSEMBLY`  
**Category:** private bushfire shelter assemblies

**Category:** precast frame elements  
**Status:** accepted

A prefabricated horizontal or sloping concrete member manufactured for lifting, bearing and connection between columns, walls, corbels or other supports.

Accepted search terms: precast beam.

Main functions: Span between supports; Carry slabs, walls or other loads; Provide final bearings and erection connections.

## precast concrete bearing pad

**ID:** `AU-CS-PRECAST-BEARING-PAD`  
**Category:** precast connections  
**Status:** accepted

A purpose-made resilient or high-strength pad placed between a precast element and its support to distribute bearing and accommodate selected rotation or irregularity.

Accepted search terms: elastomeric bearing pad.

Main functions: Distribute compressive bearing; Separate concrete bearing faces; Accommodate limited rotation or surface variation where selected.

## precast concrete column

**ID:** `AU-CS-PRECAST-CONCRETE-COLUMN`  
**Category:** precast frame elements  
**Status:** accepted

Accepted search terms: precast column.

## precast concrete connection assembly

**ID:** `AU-CS-PRECAST-CONNECTION-ASSEMBLY`  
**Category:** precast connections  
**Status:** accepted

Accepted search terms: precast joint connection.
